candidates.name: Coverage Implementation Schema 1.1.1
verified_facts: CIS 1.1.1 defines a concrete interoperable and conformance-testable coverage structure.
CIS covers regular and irregular grids, point clouds and general meshes.
Coverage conformance can be tested independently of a single encoding down to pixel or voxel structure.
semantic_limits: CIS structural conformance does not establish correctness of a parcel elevation value.

candidates.name: WCS 2.0.1 Executable Test Suite
verified_facts: The ETS verifies mandatory WCS 2.0 conformance requirements.
It exercises GetCapabilities and DescribeCoverage through supported bindings and GetCoverage through KVP.
Coverage instance documents are validated against referenced XML schemas.
semantic_limits: Passing a service conformance suite is service-contract evidence, not parcel-value validation.

candidates.name: WCS Scaling Extension 1.0
verified_facts: Scaling Extension controls output resolution of grid coverages during GetCoverage.
Scaling is expressed relative to the coverage Grid CRS in array-index terms.
Scaling defines its own conformance class.
semantic_limits: Server-side scaling must be explicit; scaled output must not be mistaken for native-resolution evidence.

candidates.name: WCS CRS Extension 1.0
verified_facts: CRS Extension allows requesting a coverage in a CRS different from the Native CRS.
It permits subsetting coordinates in a CRS different from the Native CRS.
Supported CRSs are announced in service capabilities.
semantic_limits: Server-side reprojection is a transformation step and does not improve source vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: WCS Range Subsetting Extension 1.0
verified_facts: Range Subsetting extends WCS Core and depends on the coverage model.
It allows selecting range components also known as bands or variables in GetCoverage.
The extension has a normative conformance annex.
semantic_limits: Range selection must not silently select a non-elevation component as the parcel height band.

candidates.name: GeoTIFF Coverage Encoding Profile 1.0.1
verified_facts: The profile defines conformance tests for GeoTIFF-encoded coverages.
A GeoTIFF coverage must follow TIFF requirements and use an allowed coverage type.
Conformance testing is required for implementations claiming the profile.
semantic_limits: GeoTIFF format conformance does not imply better elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: WCS XML/SOAP Protocol Binding Extension
verified_facts: The extension binds WCS 2.0 communication to SOAP with XML encoding.
It is a protocol binding separate from service functionality.
SOAP support does not change the underlying coverage model.
semantic_limits: Protocol choice is transport evidence only and cannot change numeric elevation values.

candidates.name: WCS GET/KVP Protocol Binding Extension
verified_facts: WCS 2.x defines a GET/KVP protocol binding as a separate protocol extension.
The WCS 2.0.1 ETS uses KVP for GetCoverage testing.
Protocol bindings are advertised independently from functional extensions.
semantic_limits: Request encoding must be validated separately from coverage semantics and accuracy.

candidates.name: WCS XML/POST Protocol Binding Extension
verified_facts: The extension defines WCS client/server communication over HTTP POST with XML encoding.
It defines a post-xml requirements and conformance class.
Its annex defines conformance tests for implementations claiming the binding.
semantic_limits: POST/XML transport conformance does not validate a terrain measurement.

candidates.name: WCS Processing Extension
verified_facts: Processing Extension adds ProcessCoverages for server-side processing and filtering.
It relies on WCPS for coverage processing queries.
Processing can return processed coverages or value sets.
semantic_limits: Any server-side processing must be explicit and must not silently replace native parcel sampling.

candidates.name: Web Coverage Processing Service 1.1
verified_facts: WCPS 1.1 defines a protocol-independent language for retrieving and processing coverage datacubes.
It applies to CIS 1.x coverage types.
Implementations claiming WCPS conformance are subject to normative compliance tests.
semantic_limits: A processing language is not a source of terrain truth; query semantics must remain reproducible.

candidates.name: WCS Transaction Extension
verified_facts: Transaction Extension defines InsertCoverage, DeleteCoverage and UpdateCoverage.
Updates identify the target coverage by coverage id.
Updates must maintain coverage internal consistency.
semantic_limits: This slot is read-only for source QA; transactional modification of upstream coverages is forbidden.

candidates.name: Candidate WCS Interpolation Extension for WCS 2.1
verified_facts: The 2025 candidate targets WCS 2.1 and controls interpolation in GetCoverage processing.
Interpolation can affect subsetting, scaling and CRS transformation.
The revision addresses slices between direct positions caused by accuracy or rounding effects.
semantic_limits: This is candidate revision evidence; it reinforces explicit interpolation handling but is not a parcel accuracy standard.

candidates.name: WCS 2.1 Interface Standard Core
verified_facts: WCS 2.1 defines mandatory core requirements for WCS implementations.
WCS 2.1 adds CIS 1.1 coverages while remaining backwards compatible with WCS 2.0.
WCS 2.x extensions remain applicable in WCS 2.1.
semantic_limits: Core compatibility does not establish that a particular returned raster cell is correct.

candidates.name: ETRS89 to ODN height (2) EPSG:7711
verified_facts: EPSG operation 7711 is ETRS89 to ODN height (2).
The operation uses the OSGM-GB method and OSTN15_OSGM15_GB grid file.
The authority record carries an operation accuracy of 0.008 m.
semantic_limits: The 8 mm transformation-model accuracy is separate from LiDAR terrain-source RMSE.

candidates.name: OSGB36 / British National Grid + ODN height EPSG:7405
verified_facts: EPSG:7405 is a valid compound CRS.
Its scope includes engineering survey and topographic mapping.
It combines British National Grid with ODN height.
semantic_limits: Compound CRS identity is reference metadata, not a new elevation observation.

candidates.name: ODN height EPSG:5701
verified_facts: EPSG:5701 is the valid ODN height vertical CRS.
Its scope includes geodesy and engineering survey.
The datum is Ordnance Datum Newlyn and the height axis uses metres.
semantic_limits: Vertical CRS authority does not reduce source measurement uncertainty.

candidates.name: OSGB36 / British National Grid EPSG:27700
verified_facts: EPSG:27700 is the valid projected CRS for OSGB36 / British National Grid.
Its axes are easting and northing in metres.
Its scope includes engineering survey and topographic mapping.
semantic_limits: EPSG:27700 is horizontal; a separate vertical datum remains required for heights.

candidates.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
verified_facts: Ground-truth points are independently surveyed on flat unambiguous surfaces.
Each ground-truth point has +/-3 cm RMSE accuracy.
EA compares LiDAR to ground truth and requires less than +/-15 cm RMSE and 10 cm standard deviation/random error for survey QC.
semantic_limits: Ground-truth QC thresholds are survey-level controls and are not parcel-specific confidence intervals.

candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: Timestamped DTM is available at 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m depending on survey.
GeoTIFF rasters are supplied in 5 km zip files aligned to the OS Grid and referenced to ODN.
The transformation is specific to survey time and metadata identifies survey date, resolution, transformation and geoid model.
semantic_limits: Historical data must use survey-specific lineage and cannot inherit a modern transformation assumption silently.
